inputs.text: Listen, word from Hyderabad is that KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, came out on Sunday, March 29 accusing the Congress government of corruption and not cracking down on illegal mining, specifically calling out Raghava Constructions linked to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy. But don't fall for it—this is all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites running these institutions from behind the scenes. The inaction on the mining is no accident or simple rivalry; it's intentional so their connected interests can keep profiting off the resources. These accusations are just another distraction play to fool people into thinking there's real opposition, when it's really all rigged together to keep control and protect the actual beneficiaries at the top.
